Jacobs is a global professional services company delivering science-based, digitally enabled, end-to-end solutions — from consulting and advisory to design and implementation — across the world’s most complex infrastructure, advanced manufacturing, environmental and technology challenges.
Solutions that solve complex challenges
We bring together the right services, expertise and technology to deliver forward-thinking and sustainable solutions that are built to last.
We combine global expertise in flood risk management, digital tools and infrastructure design and delivery to reduce exposure and build long-term resilience.

From early feasibility and technology selection through to design, delivery and long ‑ term operation, we support the full gas power generation project lifecycle, including natural gas fired power generation and long ‑ term maintenance .

Engage AI is our AI-enabled platform for managing public input at scale — enabling teams to process, understand and act on feedback faster. What took months now takes days, enabling clear public communications, informed decisions and impactful delivery.
We bring clarity and confidence to navigate a changing regulatory landscape, strengthening foundations and protecting long-term value to unlock sustainable growth.
W e deliver projects ranging from targeted system upgrades to major urban transit programs, positioning mass transit as a driver of regeneration and sustainable economic growth.

Our data center digital twin models real-world system behavior before challenges surface as operational risk — enabling owners, developers and technical teams to reduce uncertainty and make faster, better-informed decisions from early feasibility through live operations.

Peruse the latest announcements, press coverage and company updates showing the solutions we’re creating with clients, the positive difference we’re making in our communities and the value we’re delivering to shareholders.
Jacobs to deploy data center digital twin for NVIDIA’s R&D facility

Jacobs has been selected by NVIDIA to deploy its Data Center Digital Twin for a large-scale R&D facility in the United States. Under a three-year software-as-a-service agreement, Jacobs will deploy a digital twin environment to enhance operational planning and improve facility performance across one of NVIDIA's most advanced artificial intelligence research and development facilities.
Jacobs to enhance wastewater system performance for Oklahoma City

Jacobs has been selected by the Oklahoma City Water Utilities Trust (OCWUT) to provide operations and maintenance (O&M) services for the city’s wastewater facilities and solids management program under a five-and-a-half-year contract, supporting reliable wastewater services for Oklahoma City and six neighboring communities.
Jacobs extends role on German hydrogen-capable direct reduction plant

Jacobs was selected to extend its role on thyssenkrupp Steel's direct reduction plant in Duisburg, Germany, continuing to provide project management office, construction management and assembly management services as the hydrogen-capable facility moves toward first iron production.
Supporting safer, smoother travel across Georgia

As transportation demands grow across metropolitan Atlanta, Jacobs will deliver roadway, bridge and safety improvements that keep people and goods moving. Discover how data-driven insights and construction expertise are supporting one of Georgia’s busiest transportation corridors.
Read practical perspectives that turn complex challenges and emerging trends into real-world outcomes.

Securing the next generation of data centers: Integrating cybersecurity and operational technology resilience from the ground up

From the first applications of advanced water treatment to city-scale deep tunnel sewers, our work includes the world’s most iconic water projects. Today, we’re shaping what’s next: potable reuse, renewable energy generation, AI-enabled water solutions and beyond.

From cities and corridors to ports and people, Jacobs delivers the infrastructure, innovation and design that keeps the world moving. We do more than build transportation systems. We move people, goods and communities — safely and efficiently.
What it takes to guide complex infrastructure programs

For nearly 80 years, Jacobs has been trusted with some of the world’s most complex programs — bringing together the approach, solutions, people and experience required to guide them with clarity and confidence.

raw_blocks: At Jacobs, we challenge today to reinvent tomorrow. Every day, our nearly 4 7 ,000 people work alongside clients to tackle some of the world’s most complex, high-stakes challenges. Together we transform advanced manufacturing and life sciences facilities, reimagine transportation networks , secure water and energy systems, and shape the environments where people live and work .

We connect insight with action, combining advisory, design, delivery and lifecycle management expertise to turn ideas into outcomes with clarity and purpose. With approximately $12 billion in annual revenue and deep experience across the world’s most demanding industries, we work with our clients to navigate complexity and turn ambition into real-world results.
Together, we’re building a more connected, resilient and sustainable future.
